latHint: Think splitting a pizza evenly among friends.
pivHint: A STAKE is a pointed peg that holds a tent in the ground. In business, an investor also owns a STAKE, meaning a ______ of the company.
winText: Your piece of the pie. STAKE was the pivot - a tent peg to a SHARE of ownership.
lossText: SHARE - a part of something owned. STAKE was the pivot: a STAKE is a peg that anchors a tent, but a STAKE in a business means a piece of ownership, a SHARE of the company.
